messages:
Laura: Quick heads-up — starting onboarding for Norway region (eu-north-3) with ArcticCompute. Need quota approvals + marketplace SKU entitlements. Targeting soft-launch week of May 6. :calendar:
Mike: what's the SKU from ArcticCompute? CPU/GPU spec?
Laura: They offered `AC-rtx30-48` (48GB class), 12 units across edge-1a/1b. Proposal: reserved pool 8 + burst 4. NVLink optional for a small subset.
Jenn: Is this going through marketplace + Dedicated or one only?
Laura: Both. Marketplace SKU for self-serve, plus a Dedicated commit option for enterprise customers. We need marketplace entitlement and regional GPU quota gated for eu-north.
Oliver: FYI I opened the cloud quota ticket earlier — cloud vendor says they need a partner entitlement (marketplace listing) before they can bump regional GPU quota. :thinking:
Raj: Ops question — do we have IP ranges / peering plan ready? Need that to provision.
OpsOncall: Short list: we need IP blocks (2 x /28 per AZ), peering request, and firewall rule templates. If we get them by EOD Tue we can provision by Thu. I'll paste templates below.
OpsOncall: ```peering-request: { "project":"redwood-eu-north", "requested_ips":["10.12.16.0/28","10.12.17.0/28"], "purpose":"ArcticCompute peering for demo" }```
Mike: billing question — what's the unit name we should expose in the marketplace? instance-hour vs GPU-hour?
Laura: @Mike can you confirm billing unit names we should expose?
Mike: Use instance-hour SKU: `redwood.instance.gpu.ac_rt30_48` and metric `gpu-hours`. Alias: "AC RTX30 48GB" for UI.
Jenn: Legal review for marketplace listing + partner addendum — estimate 3 business days for standard MSA + privacy addendum. Marketing wants 1 week lead time before public announcement.
MarketplaceBot: Created MP-4821 for marketplace SKU entitlement (ArcticCompute:AC-rtx30-48). ETA: 4 business days.
Laura: Can ArcticCompute sign our MSA addendum? I pinged their partner lead yesterday.
Laura: @Sara (ArcticCompute) — can you confirm sign-off timeline?
Sara (ArcticCompute): We can get the signed addendum by Monday EOD. I'll escalate internally.
Oliver: Cloud quota ticket #Q-9012 linked to MP-4821 — assigned to cloud-eng (Eileen). She asked for partner contract + marketplace ticket before quota bump.
Laura: Action list: 1) Get signed MSA addendum from ArcticCompute (contact: sara@arcticcompute). 2) Marketplace MP-4821 in flight. 3) Network templates to Ops by Tue EOD. 4) Legal + marketing alignment (Jenn).
Raj: I'll coordinate peering windows with infra. Proposal: maintenance window 01:00–03:00 UTC Thu to minimize customer impact.
Jenn: I'll draft announcement timeline. Marketing ok with invite-only soft-launch 2 days after provisioning.
Mike: One more ask — eng-platform needs unit tests for model routing on the new SKU. Can we get a small test harness?
Laura: I'll open an eng-platform issue and tag the team.
OpsOncall: Attached firewall rule template (short): `allow tcp 1024-65535 from arcticcompute_peer_cidr to internal-gpu-nodes`
Laura: Great — anything blocking right now?
Mike: blocker: engineering test harness + signed addendum. Without those, we can't fully enable marketplace onboarding.
Jenn: I'll follow up with Legal tomorrow morning.
Sara (ArcticCompute): Thanks everyone — we'll prioritize the addendum and confirm SKU provisioning details by Monday.
MarketplaceBot: MP-4821 status -> In review by marketplace ops.
Laura: Thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated and post the eng-platform issue number once created. :thumbsup:
